reports.title: Solventum Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Guidance
section: Solventum is updating its full year 2026 guidance as follows:
•Increased organic sales growth range toward the high end of +2.5% to +3.0% (toward the high end of +3.5% to +4.0% excluding ~100 bps of SKU exit impact)
•Increased adjusted EPS range to $7.20 to $7.30; from prior range of $7.10 to $7.20
•Affirming free cash flow in the range of $200 million to $300 million
See the “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” section for explanations of our non-GAAP financial measures.

desk.headline: Sales down 7% to $1.95bn as pre-ERP orders unwound, but beat estimates; adjusted EPS $1.45 beat; full-year EPS outlook raised to $7.20–7.30

other.label: Organic sales growth
other.change: incl. ~6.3-pt drag from reversal of Q2 advance orders

results: Sales fell 7% to $1.95bn and 2.8% organically; orders customers pulled into Q2 ahead of the ERP system switch reversed, costing about 6.3 points, and last year still included the sold filtration unit.
Adjusted EPS slipped 3.6% to $1.45; on a GAAP basis it was a 7c loss per share, against a $7.22 profit last year that included a $1.5bn gain on a sale.
Adjusted gross margin rose to 57.1% from 55.8% on mix and savings; adjusted operating margin eased to 19.9% from 20.6%.
Wound care sales rose 8.9% (helped by the Acera deal) and health software 4.4% organically; dental fell 7.4% and infection prevention 5.7%.
Operating cash flow was $177m and free cash flow $97m, helped by a tariff refund; about 90% of 3M transition service deals are now exited.

guidance.summary: Solventum lifted its 2026 adjusted EPS range by 10c to $7.20–7.30, now expects organic growth near the top of its 2.5–3.0% range, and kept free cash flow at $200–300m.

items.metric: Adjusted operating margin (on call, as reported)

points: CEO Bryan Hanson called the ERP switch "the largest and most complex ERP cutover in the history of this company" and said the plan held.
Management put underlying organic growth at about 4% once the order timing is stripped out, in line with the first half, as reported.
The order reversal cost roughly $0.35 a share in the quarter, according to call coverage.
A renegotiated 3M supply deal removes a planned margin step-up from April 2027; management still expects margins to expand in 2027.
Separation of the health software business is under way; as reported, it would cut the remaining company's operating margin by about 4 points.
call.source: Call coverage: Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 5 Nov 2026; partial call transcript on StatementDog (no prepared remarks filed)

watch: Fourth-quarter organic growth now that the ERP disruption is behind it.
Progress and terms of the health software (HIS) separation.
Cash fell to $451m and $507m of debt is now due within a year.
